stimuli.title: Zain’s Morning Card
stimuli.description: A new timetable written for this test.

stimuli.title: Farid’s Saturday
stimuli.text: On Saturday morning, Farid gets up at half past seven and makes his bed. His sister gets up at eight. They brush their teeth, then read a short story at home. Before lunch, Farid washes his face and helps Mum with breakfast. In the afternoon, they play in the garden. At half past eight, Farid goes to bed.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Read a new daily schedule
questions.prompt: According to the new morning card, which action is set for 6:25?
questions.evidence: Zain’s Morning Card lists “wash his face” at 6:25.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Find a time in a new daily schedule
questions.prompt: What time does Zain leave for school?
questions.evidence: The last line of Zain’s Morning Card says he leaves for school at 7:15.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Say a quarter-to time
questions.prompt: An analogue clock shows 8:45. Which phrase tells this exact time?
questions.evidence: 8:45 is fifteen minutes before nine o’clock: quarter to nine.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Choose a present-simple form for a plural subject
questions.prompt: Two children ___ breakfast together at 7:00 each school day.
questions.evidence: “Two children” is a plural subject, so the present-simple form is “have.”

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Identify a daily-routine action
questions.prompt: Before leaving for school, Sima puts her clothes on. Which routine phrase names this action?
questions.evidence: Putting on your clothes is getting dressed.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Recognise a daily-routine action from its meaning
questions.prompt: A child is no longer asleep and begins the morning. Which action describes this?
questions.evidence: “Wake up” means stop sleeping and become awake.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Find a time in a new routine passage
questions.prompt: At what time is Farid out of bed?
questions.evidence: The passage says Farid gets up at half past seven.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Find a person and time in a new routine passage
questions.prompt: Who gets up at eight o’clock?
questions.evidence: The passage says Farid’s sister gets up at eight.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Understand a detail in a new routine passage
questions.prompt: What do Farid and his sister read together?
questions.evidence: The passage says they read a short story at home.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Check a time against a new routine passage
questions.prompt: True or False: Farid goes to bed before nine o’clock.
questions.evidence: The passage says Farid goes to bed at half past eight, which is before nine.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Write a time phrase in words
questions.prompt: A clock shows 10:45. Write this time in words.
questions.evidence: 10:45 is fifteen minutes before eleven o’clock: quarter to eleven.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Write a routine sentence in the present simple
questions.prompt: Write one complete sentence using all the notes: The twins / get up / 6:25.
accepted: the twins get up at six twenty-five
the twins get up at twenty-five past six
questions.evidence: “The twins” is plural, so the verb is “get”; the sentence is “The twins get up at 6:25.”
